user_saw: Selecting a multiword model in the Usage menu left the option unchecked and showed no matching sessions and zero usage.
summary: The fix quotes multiword values inserted by Usage filter menus and autocomplete so each value parses as a single term.
reasoning: The oldest available checkout already interpolated raw menu values as `${key}:${value}` and split the resulting query on whitespace. The September filter fix and suggestion refactor both preserved that behavior. History before the shallow boundary was unavailable offline, so I could not verify whether the original menu shipped with the defect or an earlier change introduced it.
